internal_policy.CATA_492: Real 4-mana2-durability LOCATION. Ordinary PlayCard only installs location; zero-cost UseLocation invokes Herald then Draw1. No character health or spell payload. Native last-use removal, shared occupancy/cooldown and captured continuation govern Herald failure/success and draw.
internal_policy.CATA_561: Nature hand/effect SPELL payload Herald then two ordered AddToHand(CATA_561t127584), exact 1-mana1/1 Elemental Rush. The two hand additions are independent of Soldier field capacity and Herald rank; they are not summons. Counter suppresses whole spell payload; repeated/automatic actual casts use original cast machinery.
internal_policy.EDR_871: Actual MINION battlecry adds official EDR_851t116450 0-mana1/1 Undead Wisp, then Imbue through existing class profile. Not classic CORE_CS2_231. Full-hand failed addition does not suppress Imbue. Existing Mage EDR_851p114056 and class resource histories remain native.
internal_policy.CATA_473: EndTurnSpec(controller) classifies natural owner-end body. Each original body context accepts board-ordered original active/live friendly ordinary minions including source; freezes each current Divine Shield branch once: shielded +3/+3 via BuffCapturedMinion, otherwise GrantCapturedKeyword(DIVINE_SHIELD). Effects use original MinionReference; later same-ID reentry/transform/control does not inherit accepted reward. Newly granted/lost Shield after acceptance does not change that body branch. Native max-plan repetition captures extra body contexts through original end scheduler. Exact ordering/acceptance boundaries remain uncalibrated.
